newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE - Antioch Area PFF Agency, Calif.
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Antioch Area PFF Agency, Calif.

text.p: Antioch Area Public Facilities Financing Agency
NOTICE IF HEREBY GIVEN that the Governing Board of the Antioch Area Public Facilities Financing Agency (the
Agency'') intends to offer the above-referenced bonds (the Bonds'') for public sale on

at 10:00 a.m., California time, at the offices of Public Financial Management, Inc., 505 Montgomery Street, Suite 800, San Francisco, California 94111. The Agency reserves the right to postpone or cancel the sale of the Bonds upon notice given through Thomson Municipal News (Munifacts) and Bloomberg Business News not less than twenty-four (24) hours prior to the time bids are to be received. If the sale is postponed, bids will be received at the hour and place set forth above on a date on or before July 16, 1997, as the Agency shall determine, and notice of the new date for receipt of bids shall be given by the Secretary of the Agency through Thomson Municipal News (Munifacts) and
Bloomberg Business News not less than forty-eight (48) hours prior to the time bids are to be received. As an

accommodation to bidders, telephonic or telecopied notice of the postponement of the sale date and the new sale date will be given to any bidder requesting such notice from the Agency's financial advisor, Public Financial Management, Inc., Telephone (415) 982-5544, Telecopy (415) 982-4513. Failure of any bidder to receive such telephonic or

telecopied notice shall not affect the legality of the sale. NOTICE IS HEREBY FURTHER GIVEN that the Bonds will be offered for public sale subject to the terms and conditions of the Official Notice of Sale of the Bonds, and copies of the Official Notice of Sale and of a Preliminary Official Statement relating to the Bonds will be furnished upon request to Public Financial Management, Inc., 505 Montgomery Street, Suite 800, San Francisco, California 94111,
Secretary of the Antioch Area Public
